description: Promotion case builder — Writes a promotion packet from accomplishments (evidence=) for a target level (target=): headline, summary, evidence mapped to competencies with ratings, gaps, peer-feedback asks and a recommendation. Offline readiness score (competency coverage, share of quantified accomplishments, ownership verbs, years in level from since=), tips to strengthen the case, a grounding check that no numbers were invented, and markdown. Params: evidence, target, name, current, competencies, since. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

evidence.description: e.g. Led the billing migration across 3 teams, cut invoice errors 42 percent, mentored 2 new hires, shipped usage-based pricing in Q2 that added 1.2M ARR
